OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

RST_WHOIS_API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the RST Cloud API.

RST_WHOIS_API_TIMEOUT.description: The timeout of the RST Cloud API requests, in seconds.

RST_WHOIS_API_WHOIS_OUTPUT_OBJECT.description: Where to store the WHOIS data: 'note' to create a Note attached to the entity, 'description' to update the description of the entity.

RST_WHOIS_API_UPDATE_OUTPUT_ACTION.description: How to store the WHOIS data: 'overwrite' to replace the previous data, 'append' to add the new data to the previous one.

RST_WHOIS_API_OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: The WHOIS data format: 'standard' for the basic WHOIS fields, 'extended' for additional WHOIS fields.

RST_WHOIS_API_OUTPUT_INCLUDE_RAW.description: Whether to include the raw WHOIS response in the output.
